title: Preparation of a robust hierarchical superhydrophobic surface with superior corrosion resistance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23342-23350
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02098K, Paper
Open Access

Mengqing Li, LiangJun Song, Yu Zheng, Nuoran Liu, Huizhu Yu, Rencheng Jin, Tengfei Xiang, Ruiqian Li
An armour-like hierarchical structured Zn coating is fabricated by two-step electrodeposition combined with an intermediate pre-activation, which shows robust superhydrophobicity and excellent long-term corrosion resistance.
